seoTitle: Twilight Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Twilight test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Bella, Edward, Jacob, Alice, Rosalie, Emmett, Carlisle or Charlie — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the quiet outsider, the brooding romantic, or the warm-hearted wolf? Answer 12 everyday questions about love, loyalty and fitting in, and find out which Twilight character you are.

characters.name: Bella Swan
characters.title: The Quiet Outsider
characters.summary: Shy, stubborn and selfless. You'd rather disappear than be the centre of attention, until someone you love needs you.
description: Like Bella, you're happiest out of the spotlight. She moved from sunny Phoenix to rainy Forks to live with her dad, Charlie, and dreaded being the new girl.
You notice what other people miss. Bella was the one who worked out the Cullens' secret.
You put other people first, sometimes too far. Bella would walk straight into danger to protect the people she loves, and as a vampire her gift turned out to be a shield that protects others.
characters.flaw: You'd sacrifice yourself before you'd ask anyone for help.
characters.signature: An old pickup truck and a well-worn book.
characters.clashReason: they'd refuse every bit of help you offered, then walk straight into danger anyway

characters.name: Edward Cullen
characters.title: The Brooding Romantic
characters.summary: Intense, old-fashioned and fiercely protective. You feel everything deeply, and overthink all of it.
description: Like Edward, you're a romantic with old-fashioned values. He was born in Chicago in 1901, and Carlisle turned him at 17, as he lay dying of Spanish flu.
You read people better than anyone. Edward can literally read minds, except Bella's.
You'd do anything to protect the people you love, even leave them. Edward walked away from Bella to keep her safe, and it nearly broke them both.
characters.flaw: You decide what's best for people without asking them.
characters.signature: A piano, a song you wrote for someone, and a lot of brooding.
characters.clashReason: they'd decide what's best for you without ever asking

characters.name: Jacob Black
characters.title: The Warm Heart
characters.summary: Sunny, loyal and quick to anger. You love hard and wear your heart on your sleeve.
description: Like Jacob, you're warm company and easy to be around. He's part of the Quileute tribe at La Push, and the son of Charlie's fishing buddy, Billy Black.
You're good with your hands. Jacob was rebuilding his own car, an old Volkswagen Rabbit, when he helped Bella fix up a pair of old motorbikes.
Your temper runs hot. Jacob turned out to be a shape-shifter who becomes a giant wolf, and anger is what sets it off.
characters.flaw: You act first and think later, especially when you're angry.
characters.signature: A big grin, a toolbox and no shirt.
characters.clashReason: they'd lose their temper before you'd finished your sentence

characters.name: Alice Cullen
characters.title: The Optimistic Planner
characters.summary: Bubbly, stylish and always one step ahead. You've planned the party before anyone knows there is one.
description: Like Alice, you light up a room. She's the most cheerful of the Cullens, and she loves shopping, makeovers and throwing parties.
You can see where things are heading. Alice can see the future, but only once someone has made a decision, so when people change their minds, her visions change too.
You make things happen. Alice threw Bella's 18th birthday party and planned her wedding, whether Bella wanted it or not.
characters.flaw: You'll plan someone's life for them if they let you, and sometimes if they don't.
characters.signature: A shopping bag in each hand and the whole night already planned.
characters.clashReason: they'd plan every minute of your weekend without asking

characters.name: Rosalie Hale
characters.title: The Fierce Realist
characters.summary: Blunt, guarded and fiercely loyal once you've let someone in. You say what other people won't.
description: Like Rosalie, you don't let people in easily. She's the most beautiful of the Cullens, and the coldest towards Bella at first.
Your toughness comes from somewhere. Rosalie was turned in the 1930s after a brutal attack by her fiancé, Royce King, and she made sure he and his friends paid for it.
You want the life you can't have. Rosalie would trade everything to be human and have a family, which is why she fought so hard for Bella's baby.
characters.flaw: You hold a grudge for a very, very long time.
characters.signature: A red convertible and a look that could freeze you.
characters.clashReason: they'd tell you exactly what they think of you, to your face

characters.name: Emmett Cullen
characters.title: The Big Kid
characters.summary: Fun, competitive and impossible to dislike. Life's a game, and you're playing to win.
description: Like Emmett, you're the life of the house. He's the biggest of the Cullens and the one who's always joking, betting and picking fights for fun.
You'll take on anything. Emmett was mauled by a bear in Tennessee in 1935, and Rosalie carried him more than 100 miles to Carlisle to save him.
You hate losing. When Bella became a vampire, she beat Emmett at arm wrestling, and he took it very badly.
characters.flaw: You can't turn down a bet, even when you should.
characters.signature: A big Jeep, a bigger laugh and a bet on the side.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn every single thing into a competition

characters.name: Carlisle Cullen
characters.title: The Compassionate Leader
characters.summary: Calm, kind and endlessly patient. You see the best in people, even when they can't.
description: Like Carlisle, you're the one people turn to. He's the head of the Cullen family and a doctor at the hospital in Forks.
You've learned a lot from life. Carlisle was born in London in the 1640s, the son of a pastor, and was turned after being attacked by a vampire.
You choose to be good. Carlisle taught himself to live on animal blood so he'd never have to kill a person, and he's spent centuries saving lives.
characters.flaw: You give second chances to people who don't deserve them.
characters.signature: A doctor's bag and a calm voice in a crisis.
characters.clashReason: they'd stay calm and forgiving while you're furious

characters.name: Charlie Swan
characters.title: The Man of Few Words
characters.summary: Low-key, steady and awkward with feelings. You show you care by being there, not by talking about it.
description: Like Charlie, you keep it simple. He's the police chief of Forks, and his idea of a great weekend is fishing with his friends.
You're not one for big speeches. Charlie and Bella can get through a whole dinner barely saying a word, and they're both fine with that.
You protect people quietly. Charlie never really trusted Edward again after he left Bella, but he'd do anything to keep his daughter safe.
characters.flaw: You'd rather fix a leaky tap than talk about your feelings.
characters.signature: A police cruiser, a fishing rod and the game on TV.
characters.clashReason: they'd answer every big conversation with a nod and an 'okay'

questions.text: It's your birthday, and your friends want to throw you a party. You...

options.text: Beg them not to. You hate being the centre of attention
Tell them it's too late. You've already planned it: theme, outfits, the lot
Agree, as long as there's a competition you can win
Ask for a quiet dinner and the game on TV instead

questions.text: Someone you like texts you: "We need to talk." You...

options.text: Assume it's bad news, and that it's probably your fault
Call them straight away. You can't wait to find out
Reply "ok" and hope it's not about feelings
Stay calm. You'll hear them out before you worry

questions.text: A friend asks you to help them move house on Saturday. You...

options.text: Bring a couple of mates and turn it into a fun day
Carry the heaviest things and race everyone up the stairs
Make a colour-coded plan for every box
Say you're busy. Carrying boxes isn't your thing

questions.text: You've just moved to a new town and don't know anyone. On your first day, you...

options.text: Keep your head down and hope nobody notices you
Introduce yourself to everyone. You'll have friends by lunch
Look out for anyone else who seems lonely
Keep to yourself. If people want to know you, they can make the effort

questions.text: Someone cuts in right in front of you at the coffee shop. You...

options.text: Tell them, loudly, where the back of the line is
Lose your temper and get in their face before you can stop yourself
Make a joke about it loud enough that everyone laughs at them
Let it go. Maybe they're having a bad day

questions.text: It's pouring with rain all weekend, and your plans are cancelled. You...

options.text: Curl up with a book you've already read ten times
Put on some old music and get lost in your thoughts
Spend the whole day in the garage fixing up an old car
Go fishing anyway. A bit of rain never stopped anyone

questions.text: Your friend is dating someone you think is bad news. You...

options.text: Tell them straight. They won't like it, but they need to hear it
Quietly ask around about them. You have your ways
Get to know them first. Everyone deserves a fair chance
Keep checking in on your friend to make sure they're safe

questions.text: You've hurt someone you care about, badly. You...

options.text: Decide they're better off without you, and step back
Apologise right there and then, and tell them exactly how you feel
Make it up to them with a big, perfectly planned surprise
Take all the blame, even for the parts that weren't your fault

questions.text: A friend asks to borrow money you know they won't pay back. You...

options.text: Lend it anyway. Maybe they'll surprise you
Say no. You've been burned before, and you haven't forgotten
Offer them double or nothing on a game of pool
Hand it over and never mention it again, even though you're short yourself

questions.text: Your group can't decide what to do on Friday night. You...

options.text: Book something fun. You just know everyone's going to love it
Push for bowling or paintball. Anything with a winner
Suggest the same diner as always. Why change a good thing?
Vote for a quiet night in. Big crowds aren't your thing

questions.text: You're a vampire who's lived for a hundred years, and you've just fallen for a human. You...

options.text: Stay away from them. You're too dangerous
Warn them what they'd be giving up. You'd never wish this life on anyone
Don't worry about it. You've got a good feeling about this one
Go for it. You've got forever, so why not have some fun?

questions.text: Your small town is in danger, and only you and a few friends know about it. You...

options.text: Try to talk to the other side before anyone gets hurt
Get your friends together and get ready to fight
Keep everyone safe without telling them more than they need to know
Offer yourself up, if it means everyone else is safe
